title: Handoff (base)
description:
One agent passing work to another. Referenced by triage-result and verdict rather than emitted alone. agents-md-schema.md rule 13.

This is the BASE: it fixes the shape and leaves the role vocabulary to the repository, because role names are per-repository by design (agents-md-schema.md rule 10 keeps the repository prefix). A consuming repository composes it with `allOf` and narrows `from` and `to` to its own enum, and may add a property of its own: this base declares no `additionalProperties` and no `unevaluatedProperties`, because a base that closes itself cannot be extended — `additionalProperties: false` refuses the added field, and `unevaluatedProperties: false` refuses it too, seeing only the annotations of its own schema object and its in-place applicators and never a sibling `allOf` branch in the composing schema. The closer belongs to the composition, at the root of the schema that `$ref`s this one and in every subschema that extends a shape here; nothing else refuses a foreign property, and `agents_file_check.py` reports a composition that carries no closer.

This file carries no `$id`: the bundle is vendored and every `$ref` into it is a relative path, so it resolves from the filesystem — on github.com, in CI without a network, and in a fresh clone alike. An `$id` would make the canonical identifier a URL that must then be fetched or registered.

reason.description: Why this role and not the current one. Names the constraint the receiving role owns.

blocking.description: true when the sender may not proceed until the receiver has answered. A role that owns something expensive to correct later — a reserved number, a chosen template — is blocking by design.

context_refs.description: Paths or record ids the receiver needs. Repository-relative: a path under a home directory is not portable and the agent-file check reports it.

agentRef.description: A role name, or `human`. Narrowed to the repository's own enum by the composing schema.
